verdict.rationale: Superhuman Mail is an AI-native email client that processes inbox content for drafts, labels and search, so a training opt-out is a fair question to ask. However, nothing in the evidence pack documents a training opt-out, a no-training commitment, or any data-use policy for AI models. The community privacy complaints concern read-tracking pixels, not AI training, so they are not relevant here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
